Subject used at send time when `subject` still contains unresolved
template variables.

body.description:
HTML body of the email. Template variables and snippets are kept as
`{{ ... }}` tokens and are resolved at send time. Null while the copy is
being prepared.

is_ready.description:
False while template variables and snippets are still being resolved.
The email is not sent until the copy is ready.

is_edited.description: True when the copy was changed after it was first generated.

is_root_message.description:
True for the first email of a thread. Subjects can only be set on root
messages. Replies reuse the thread's subject.

is_blocked.description:
True when the email cannot be sent in its current state, for example
because of unresolved template variables or a mailbox problem.

UpdateEnrollmentStepRequest.description:
Request body for updating the email copy of an enrollment step. At least
one of `subject`, `fallback_subject` or `body` must be provided.

- `subject` and `fallback_subject` are only accepted on root messages.
- `body` is HTML. Template variables and snippets are written as `{{ ... }}`
tokens. Must not be blank.
- `version_id` is the copy version the edit is based on. The update is
rejected with a conflict when the copy has changed since that version.

UpdateEnrollmentStepSuccessResponse.description: Response returned when an enrollment step's email copy is updated.
